text:
raja: Hey folks, seeing a recurring p99 latency spike during long-context runs. Grafana: kv_pager.evictions/s spike to 120/s at 14:12 UTC, host rwd-infer-12. Link: https://grafana.redwood/abc123
olivia: yeah noticed that earlier, correlates with >64k token contexts, memory climbs then paging starts.
kim: small repro on staging: run long-chat multi-turn + burst queries, eviction latency goes from 0.8ms -> 25ms.
alex: can you paste `kv_pager` counters? I want alloc_fail and reclaim_time.
raja: counters excerpt: `evict_attempts=482, evict_success=461, reclaim_wait_us=23400, reinserts=79` — reclaim_wait_us jumps when fragmentation >70%
maria: hunch: slab boundary alignment causing reinsert ordering to change; we saw something like that with the -opt-kernel change last week.
olivia: I profiled with perf and got heavy time in `evict_walk()` and `reinsert_chain()` when we choose FIFO under high pressure. stack: `evict_walk -> free_slab -> reinsert_chain`
perf-bot: [profile uploaded] flamegraph: top frames: evict_walk, memcopy, parse_kv_entry 
kim: here's the suspicious diff I found in pager: `if (age < last_used) insert_front(entry); else insert_back(entry);` — looks inverted in one branch after refactor.
alex: omg that would flip LRU semantics for entries crossing slab boundaries. Good catch.
raja: repro script: `./test_long_context.sh --model=redwood-7b --turns=120 --burst=8` — run on staging vm to reproduce within ~5min.
maria: quick mitigation: flip the comparator back and add a per-slab sequence counter to preserve ordering across slabs.
olivia: also note batching heuristics change last month increased average sequence length which makes entries straddle slabs more often. Could be why this surfaced now.
kim: I pushed a small patch in branch `fix/kv-reinsert-order` that flips the comparator and adds an assert. PR: https://git.redwood/p/2345
alex: run the canary with `--evict-policy=forced-lru` and monitor `reinsert_latency_ms`. If improves, roll to prod.
raja: ran canary for 30m: reinsert_latency 23ms -> 1.1ms, p99 request latency back to baseline.
maria: we should add a unit test for slab-crossing reinserts and a deterministic stress test to catch regressions.
perf-bot: CI perf check queued for branch fix/kv-reinsert-order (job #982).
olivia: follow-up: file a small postmortem and add a tracing tag `kv.slabs.cross` so future traces show slab crossings.
raja: agreed. I'll open the postmortem and link graphs. Thanks all :thumbsup:
alex: nice triage — let's schedule a brief sync to discuss long-context batching impacts on eviction heuristics tomorrow 10:00 UTC.
raja: added calendar invite.
